amendment: id=lstm-tuning-fallback. The pre-registered tuning sweep (3 learning rates x 3 entropy coefficients x 3 seeds, 300k transitions, validation only) was uninformative for the LSTM: every configuration finished within noise of an untrained policy (validation survival 99.7-106.7; the 106.7 ties are the untrained deterministic policy), so 'first best in grid order' would have selected lr=1e-4 by tie-break. Decision, made before any memory-track run: the LSTM and the SSM use the feedforward sweep's selected pair (lr=1e-3, entropy=0.003). The difference in tuning effort is recorded here and in the manifest, and the memory-track comparison is not called controlled with respect to tuning. No other plan item is changed.
